ttm.shares_basis: duration-weighted average of the four quarterly diluted weighted-average counts (a fiscal-Q4 count derived as 4 x FY - the other three quarters)

dividends.dps_basis_detail: declared facts for periods ending 2014-06-30..2026-06-30; paid facts for the periods the declared tag does not cover (2012-12-31..2014-03-31, 3 facts); the paid tag stopped: its newest fact (2015-12-31) is 3834 days older than the declared tag's (2026-06-30) — declared is primary
dividends.frequency_basis: 3 quarterly DPS facts inside FY2025 (2025-01-01..2025-12-31) plus one payment carried only in the FY total; the per-share facts are filed per quarter — a payment cadence inside the quarter (a monthly payer) is not tagged
dividends.fy_label_basis: calendar year of the fiscal period end (the annual table's convention)
dividends.flows_basis: sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-09-30..2026-06-30

buybacks.basis: 2/4 quarters covered (the six-month year-to-date fact 2026-01-01..2026-06-30 = 170.0M (PaymentsForRepurchaseOfCommonStock, filed 2026-08-06)) — a lower bound

dividends.shareholder_yield_basis: dividends_paid (4/4 quarters filed) + buybacks (2/4 quarters covered (the six-month year-to-date fact 2026-01-01..2026-06-30 = 170.0M (PaymentsForRepurchaseOfCommonStock, filed 2026-08-06)) — a lower bound) − share_issuance (4/4 quarters filed); sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-09-30..2026-06-30

dps_ttm: the latest four quarterly DPS facts are not consecutive quarters (182 days between 2025-09-30 and 2026-03-31) — FY2025 DPS 2.48 + the quarters since (2026-03-31: 0.65, 2026-06-30: 0.65) − the same quarters a year earlier (2025-03-31: 0.62, 2025-06-30: 0.62)

buybacks_ttm: not all of the last four quarters have a filed buybacks figure (missing 2025-09-30, 2025-12-31) — the six-month year-to-date fact 2026-01-01..2026-06-30 = 170.0M (PaymentsForRepurchaseOfCommonStock, filed 2026-08-06) covers 2 of them
